blocks.html: Robinsons Hotels & Resorts celebrates its win at TripZilla awards and reaffirms its commitment to exceptional hospitality through innovative services and memorable guest experiences.

Robinsons Hotels & Resorts, a leading brand in the Philippine hospitality industry, is proud to announce its triple victory at the prestigious TripZilla Excellence Awards 2024. The brand received accolades in three key categories:

items: Best Hotel for Families – Summit Ridge Tagaytay
Best Budget Hotel – Go Hotels Plus Mandaluyong

blocks.html: “Our commitment to excellence is reflected in every aspect of our operations, from the seamless experience offered to business travelers at Summit Galleria Cebu, to the family-friendly amenities and scenic location of Summit Ridge Tagaytay, and the unbeatable value provided by Go Hotels Plus Mandaluyong,” said Barun Jolly, Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager of Robinsons Hotels & Resorts. “We are deeply grateful for this recognition from the travel community and remain inspired to raise the bar in Philippine hospitality.”

This recognition underscores Robinsons Hotels & Resorts' unwavering dedication to delivering exceptional service, innovative hospitality solutions, and unique guest experiences tailored to diverse traveler needs.

TripZilla is a leading travel media company in Southeast Asia reaching more than 20 million travellers every month. The TripZilla Excellence Awards, now in its landmark 10th year, is a highly coveted honour in the travel industry, celebrating brands that have crafted exceptional and unforgettable travel experiences.
To learn more about Robinsons Hotels and Resorts and our award-winning products and services, please visit https://www.robinsonshotels.com/.

With 30 Hotels and over 5000 keys , Robinsons Hotels & Resorts, a business unit of Robinsons Land Corporation, is the largest hospitality group in the Philippines by number of hotels. It is known for its diverse portfolio of hotels and resorts across the country. Committed to providing excellent guest experiences, RHR emphasizes sustainability, innovation, and Filipino hospitality in all its properties.

The prestigious TripZilla Excellence Awards, now in its landmark 10th year, is dedicated to recognising the top travel organisations in the industry. This esteemed event honours the most outstanding travel companies, celebrating their unparalleled achievements that have set new standards of excellence and elevated the industry to new heights.
Companies that exemplify the best in travel are nominated and awarded through an extensive online voting process conducted on TripZilla, which reaches over 20 million travellers each month
